what: The scripts made for norns-js that the script store offers before they are on norns.community (E9-213). tools/build-own-scripts.mjs copies each from norns-scripts/<name>/ into public/own-scripts/<name>/ and writes the index the store reads. When one is published in the catalogue, take it out of this list: the catalogue's entry wins anyway.
author: pinktentacle
